title: Universal Isotropy and Genus-Proportional Integral Hodge Defects on Dyadic Enriques Products
decided_scope: Explicit dyadic Enriques surface S_new over Q(sqrt(2)) with Picard torsion G_(pi,pi) such that for EVERY smooth projective complex curve C of genus g >= 1, the correspondence pullback A_C in H^1(C, F_2) is totally isotropic and the degree-4 integral Hodge defect of C x S_new has F_2-dimension at least g
open_boundaries: The classical rational Hodge conjecture on smooth projective complex varieties
